news.headline: Play the long game: Trade for these fantasy hoops players before they heat up
McCain finished Sunday's 123-113 loss to the Heat with 20 points (7-17 FG, 2-7 3Pt, 4-5 FT), two rebounds and three assists in 29 minutes.

However, limited assists and Shai Gilgeous-Alexander's (back/neck) eventual return could reduce the former's opportunities.

team_injuries.note: Wallace underwent surgery Friday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

team_injuries.name: Chet Holmgren
team_injuries.note: Holmgren underwent a biological treatment Friday to address a small patellar tendon tear and will miss at least 8-10 weeks, Nick Crain of Slam reports.

opp_injuries.name: Kasparas Jakucionis
opp_injuries.note: Jakucionis (ankle) won't play Friday's game against the Pistons.

news.headline: Gilgeous-Alexander finished with 32 points (13-26 FG, 1-7 3Pt, 5-7 FT), three rebounds, five assists and two blocks over 37 minutes in Wednesday's 113-106 loss to Minnesota.
news.story: Gilgeous-Alexander scored over 30 points for the seventh consecutive game, though his efforts weren't enough to help Oklahoma City avoid a third straight loss. The multi-time MVP is now averaging 32.1 points per contest, the second-best mark of his career.
